title: edikt plan criteria sidecar
description: Spec-only criteria sidecar (PLAN-<slug>-criteria.yaml) consumed by `bin/edikt verify`. Mirrors tools/edikt/internal/verify/schema.go, which strict-decodes (KnownFields) — any field not listed here makes verify exit 2. Evaluation state (status, fail_count, fail_reason, …) does NOT belong in this file; it lives in .edikt/state/plan-eval/PLAN-<slug>-eval.json (see plan-eval-state.v1.schema.json). Two constraints live only in the Go validator, which remains authoritative: phase ids must be unique across the file, and criterion ids must be unique within a phase. Ids and created accept unquoted YAML scalars (numbers, dates) because Go's yaml.v3 coerces scalars into string fields; quoting them is still the recommended style.

schema_version.description: Discrete integer version (same convention as gov-sidecar.v1): the shape is a v1-or-v2 contract, not semver-evolved.

created.description: ISO-8601 date. Untyped on purpose: unquoted YAML dates parse as date objects, and the Go decoder accepts them into its string field.

id.description: Phase identifier, unique across the file. Unquoted numeric ids are accepted (yaml.v3 coerces them to string); quoting (id: "1") is the recommended style.

classification.description: testable = every criterion carries an executable verify command; operational = observable but not machine-checkable; informational = context only.

id.description: Criterion identifier, unique within the phase, e.g. AC-2.1. Unquoted numeric ids (id: 1.1) are accepted; quoting is the recommended style.

verify.description: Shell command exiting 0 when the criterion holds. Required when the phase is testable; omit the key entirely (never verify: null) otherwise.

verify_kind.description: Cheat-rate scoring metadata (structural | behavioral). The Go decoder does not constrain the value.

dependencies.description: Optional DAG edges between phases, keyed by phase id.
